supported_claims: The tested owned specimen has deterministic FAR=open/raw 1 and NEAR=closed/raw 0 behavior in the temporary bench topology.
Twenty complete near/far cycles completed with 40 stable movements, zero mismatches and zero buffer overflows.
No movement produced more than one raw transition at the 250 us harness sampling resolution.
A disconnected contact conductor produces the same raw HIGH state as an open contact in the tested two-wire pull-up topology.
The ESP32-C3 internal pull-up was adequate for this temporary bench session.
limitations: Applies only to specimen MC38-A and the recorded bench session.
Does not establish universal MC-38/DC-38 specifications or replacement equivalence.
Does not establish production reliability or oscilloscope-grade bounce timing.
Does not distinguish legitimate open contact from disconnected wire or other failed-open conditions.
Does not freeze final GPIO, debounce, pull network, cable, protection, power budget or mounting geometry.
Does not support alarm, tamper, intrusion-detection, antifurto, access-control, safety or certification claims.
